scope: Three streetscape fitting families; morphology observed in photos, all positions/counts/dimensions estimated on existing OSM-derived model.

references.author: Bohao Zhao
supports: thin tapered promenade lantern with cage ribs and shallow domed cap
railing inclined supports, many thin round horizontal rods and thick round handrail

references.author: Suicasmo
supports: pole extending above curved rising branch
slim rounded slightly rising streetlight head

position_basis: Preserved original crossing-anchored road lamp estimates and same 32m nominal promenade pattern; unchanged merged OSM west-bank shoreline and rail setback .65m. These are not street furniture surveyed coordinates.
traffic_signals: OSM traffic_signal points were not used to infer pole locations.
omissions: No waste bins placed: visible examples could not be reliably matched to points within the model crop.
inferred_numeric_design: All metre dimensions and number of rails/cage ribs are photo-proportioned estimates, not measurements.
